newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rodamco sees 97/98 net/shr up by 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rodamco sees 97/98 net/shr up by 10 pct.

text.p: Dutch property investment fund Rodamco, part of the Robeco Group, on Tuesday reiterated an earlier forecast that it expected its 1997/98 net earnings per share to increase by around 10 percent to 3.00 guilders.
